mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the cold response with skeletal muscle was most worthwhile because it connected shivering to ATP use and heat production, complementing the earlier step that conserved heat.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial warming sequence was somewhat rigid: sweating seemed like a plausible immediate response, but the game first required the skin-vessel step. The compatibility feedback made that sequence clear.

surprise.text: The cooling result showed the sweat-driving signal fading as core temperature moved toward its earlier range, making the feedback response more visible.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the skin-vessel response before activating sweat glands felt somewhat arbitrary; the descriptions explained both responses but did not make that required order obvious beforehand.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: this one connected sensing, circulation, sweating and muscle work in a clear sequence, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
